sources.text:
Lake Erastvere (Estonian: Erastvere järv) is a lake in Estonia. It is located in the village of Erastvere in Kanepi Parish, Põlva County.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 15.8 hectares (39 acres). The lake has an average depth of 3.5 meters (11 ft) and a maximum depth of 9.7 meters (32 ft). It is 810 meters (2,660 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 1,890 meters (6,200 ft).
